title: Input position indexing
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $N,T,t,p$ be natural numbers with $p<N+2$. Set $S=k(2T+1)+N+3$. The configuration position encoded by the index $tS+k(2T+1)+p$ is the input position $(t,p)$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite-state Turing machine over Boolean symbols
